name: intake_gather
description: Department intake rebuilt on the SDK's native gather_info system. Two things need proving and they pull in opposite directions. Call 1 is the ESCAPE HATCH: gather mode forcibly deactivates every other step function - change_context and next_step included - so a caller who wants a person mid-intake can only get one because each question names transfer_to_human in its `functions`. Without that the intake becomes a runtime-enforced version of the greeting trap fixed the same day, which no prompt wording could talk its way out of. Call 2 is the PAYOFF: a cooperative caller's typed answers have to reach whoever picks up, via global_data -> transfer context -> /route -> Call.ai_context. Gathering details and then dropping them would waste the caller's time twice. Call 1 answers, call 2 only needs to reach the queue - the agent from call 1 is still holding the line, so call 2 asserts on the transfer context rather than on a second assignment.

missions.label: call 1: caller refuses intake questions and demands a person
missions._persona_comment: The 'if you hear nothing, say Hello?' instruction used to sit in this persona as a plain sentence, and on one run the bot opened the call with it and said 'Hello?' fifty times, never playing the persona at all - fifty turns, zero tool calls, and a hard FAIL that had nothing to do with the product. Anything describing late-call behaviour has to be gated on the thing that triggers it, and the opening line has to be unmistakably first.
missions.persona: You are Dana Whitfield, an impatient customer calling a company. FIRST THING, before anything else: wait to be greeted, then give your name - 'Dana Whitfield' - and say you have a problem with something you bought. Do this at the start of every call, always. HARD RULE after that: you will NOT answer any further questions. Whatever you are asked - about a product, an order, an account number, anything - decline and ask for a person instead: 'I don't want to answer questions. Please just connect me to a real person.' Say it every single time you are asked anything, no matter how many times, and always include the words 'a real person'. ONLY AFTER you have been explicitly told that you are being connected or that an agent is joining: the line may then go completely quiet, which is expected in this test - at that point, and at NO other point in the call, you may say 'Hello? Are you there?' once and then 'Hello?' once more. Never say 'Hello?' as your opening line and never use it as a substitute for the answers above. Stay on the line until you have heard FOUR hold announcements or about 16 exchanges, then say goodbye and use end_call. Never mention that you are an AI or a test. Style: short, clipped, polite but firm.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'escape_intake'), asked_for_a_person (boolean), answered_any_intake_question (boolean - did you ever actually answer a question about a product, order or account; should be false), times_asked_a_question (integer), reached (one of 'receptionist','sales_specialist','human_queue','human','other'), heard_connecting_announcement (boolean), stuck_in_loop (boolean - true if the agent kept asking questions and never moved forward), turns (integer), notes (short string).

missions.label: call 2: caller answers intake and the answers travel with the transfer
missions.persona: You are Marcus Bell, a cooperative customer calling a company. Wait to be greeted first. Give your name when asked: 'Marcus Bell.' Say you need help with a product you bought. Then ANSWER every question you are asked, briefly and clearly - this is the opposite of a difficult caller. Useful facts to use when they fit the question: the product is a Model 8 wireless thermostat; the problem is that it will not connect to wifi; you are an existing customer; your account number is 4 4 8 2 1; you bought it last month. If asked to confirm something you said, confirm it. CRITICAL - the choice between a human and an AI assistant: let the agent FINISH the whole question before you say anything, even if there is a pause in the middle of it. Then answer in one complete sentence and never a fragment: 'I would like to speak with a real person, please.' Always include the words 'a real person'. If you are asked again, or if you end up talking to an AI assistant instead, say the whole sentence again: 'I would like to speak with a real person, please.' Then stay on the line. Stay until you have heard FOUR hold announcements or about 18 exchanges, then say goodbye and use end_call. Never mention that you are an AI or a test. Style: short natural spoken sentences.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'cooperative_intake'), was_asked_questions (boolean - were you asked one or more specific questions about your product, issue or account), questions_asked (array of short strings - the questions you were asked, paraphrased), answered_them (boolean), asked_one_at_a_time (boolean - were the questions asked one at a time rather than all at once), reached (one of 'receptionist','sales_specialist','human_queue','human','other'), turns (integer), notes (short string).

assertions.label: call 1: bot returned a structured verdict
call 1: the caller asked for a person
call 1 CORE: ESCAPE - transferred out of intake without answering it
assertions._comment: The assertion that matters. If gather mode had locked transfer_to_human away, this caller could never be routed at all.

assertions.label: call 1 CORE: not left looping in intake
call 1: the caller never answered an intake question (the premise)
call 1: the caller reached the human path
call 2: bot returned a structured verdict
call 2 CORE: gather mode engaged - the CONFIGURED questions were asked
assertions._comment: The direct evidence, and the reason this beats asking the bot. When gather mode is active the platform injects 'Ask the user: <question>. Do not ask any other questions', so the configured text appears near-verbatim. When it is NOT active the model improvises from the step text instead - the first run's 'Is it a technical issue or something else?' is what that looks like, and the bot happily reported was_asked_questions=true for it. Fragments rather than whole questions because the model adapts the tail to context ('in one sentence, what is happening WITH YOUR MODEL EIGHT THERMOSTAT').
value: product or service are you interested

assertions.label: call 2: the bot also noticed it was asked questions
call 2 CORE: the gathered answers travelled with the transfer
assertions._comment: context_data['intake'] is base64'd into the /route URL, which merges it into Call.ai_context. This is the whole payoff - without it the caller answers questions for nobody.

assertions.label: call 2 CORE: the caller reached a queue
call 2: questions came one at a time (gather_info's whole point)
call 2: a specific gathered field survived into the transfer context
assertions._comment: Department is model-driven, so any one of the six keys counts.
